reviewedScope: Full existing contract plus appended C0/C1-shadow/C2 stages, invalidation controls and separate performance hypotheses; matching EDN stages and resource/qualification fields.
findings: C0 is correctly limited to exact activation-local memo under immutable context. Finite V8 evidence does not become persistent ComputeCID or native CID encoding.

C1/C2 explicitly unimplemented in prose and EDN; shared-cache-enabled and native-cid-encoder-implemented remain false. C1 always evaluates directly and tests stable-reference replay into fresh callee aggregates.

ComputeCID binds evaluator transitive implementation, subject/graph, complete read footprint, bounds/modes, rules/semantics/ABI and relevant admission state; ResultCID includes edge contributions/support/poison/diagnostics and observable charges. CAS hash alone is not calculation correspondence proof.
Publication rejects partial/refused/unsupported work; corrupt or stale references do not apply partial updates. Valid-last and separate current-authority contracts are retained.

Logical admission/charge is distinguished from physical work; budget-in-key alone explicitly insufficient. Warm/cold/shared-disabled must retain bytes,exports,diagnostics and logical charge with identical local memo/optimization configuration. Physical exhaustion cannot silently alter optimization choices.

Importer size/depth/reference/edge/entry checks precede allocation; decode/hash/materialize/resolve/validate/replay/store/evict/cleanup and fallback all bounded. These remain design requirements, not implementation claims.
Result equality permits downstream stop only with complete unchanged direct read footprint; graph/type/effect/ABI direct reads invalidate. Physical timing/hit rate kept out of semantic ResultCID.
Invalidation table covers altered context/evaluator/rules/ABI/edge/ref/fuel/publication/schema; stage contract requires fresh aggregate update parity, not value-only comparison.

Analysis reuse and generated-program runtime hypotheses are explicitly separate. Identical generated bytes cannot claim Embench runtime gain from cache; whole encoder/hash/lookup/validation/replay/storage overhead is included.

Historical positive fixture and checkpoint results retain narrow evidence boundaries and failures; staged additions do not claim original19 performance, shared import qualification or product adoption.
futurePreregistrationObligations: Before C1 source authoring, freeze exact canonical codec/schema, complete read-footprint extraction, stable-reference bridge, bounded importer/publisher and finite work/size caps, ownership/rollback behavior and adversarial controls.

Before C2 native qualification, define deterministic logical charges including charge read-state; bind host/cohort/producer and cold/warm/shared-disabled comparison protocol, budgets, stop-on-failure and 3-generation byte identity.
Measure compiler analysis with all cache overhead and generated runtime with matched original19/C host controls independently; do not infer performance from hash/certificate/omission counts.
limits: Read-only local document consistency review, not external research or proof of the proposed cache.
No C1/C2 implementation/runtime experiment, native, compilation, timing, deployment or adoption.
